schema: CREATE TABLE graph_meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE math_question (question_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, stem TEXT NOT NULL, options_json TEXT NOT NULL, answer_reference TEXT NOT NULL, review_status TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE math_knowledge (knowledge_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE math_question_knowledge (question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES math_question(question_id), knowledge_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES math_knowledge(knowledge_id), relation TEXT NOT NULL, review_status TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(question_id,knowledge_id))

CREATE TABLE math_knowledge_claim (claim_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES math_question(question_id), expert TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, statement TEXT NOT NULL, review_status TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE math_solution (solution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES math_question(question_id), expert TEXT NOT NULL, steps_text TEXT NOT NULL, critical_step TEXT NOT NULL, review_status TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE math_error_path (error_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES math_question(question_id), expert TEXT NOT NULL, option_label TEXT NOT NULL, analysis_json TEXT NOT NULL, review_status TEXT NOT NULL, source_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE math_hint (hint_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES math_question(question_id), level INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(level IN (1,2)), text TEXT NOT NULL, review_status TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(question_id,level))

CREATE TABLE math_knowledge_relation (relation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, from_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES math_knowledge(knowledge_id), to_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES math_knowledge(knowledge_id), relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation IN ('prerequisite','related')), evidence TEXT NOT NULL, review_status TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(from_id<>to_id))

CREATE TABLE behavior_pattern (
  pattern_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  description TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE behavior_example (
  example_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  pattern_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES behavior_pattern(pattern_code),
  source_problem_log_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  source_skill TEXT,
  source_problem_type TEXT,
  target_question_id TEXT,
  action_sequence TEXT NOT NULL,
  first_action_ms INTEGER,
  last_action_ms INTEGER,
  wrong_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  right_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hint_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  previous_same_skill_unresolved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  previous_same_skill_hints INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  legacy_frustrated REAL,
  legacy_confused REAL,
  legacy_concentrating REAL,
  legacy_bored REAL,
  review_status TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE example_emotion_hypothesis (
  hypothesis_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  example_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES behavior_example(example_id),
  emotion_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  emotion_zh TEXT NOT NULL,
  strength TEXT NOT NULL,
  origin TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_primary INTEGER NOT NULL,
  review_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (example_id, emotion_code)
)
